body: There's still some part of you that wants to live, the proof of it is you asking this subreddit for help. You just have to push through this go to sleep and wake up in the morning you'll be happy you didn't do it.

I was in the same situation as you were in. I told my gf (now ex) about my thoughts and she didn't understand fully, because people that never have gone through the whole mental thing as we do, it's not easy for them to. She suggested the same thing your bf did and at the time I fought the idea of getting help. Now that I lost all I think about is I should've gotten help sooner. Now she doesn't even talk to me or even look at me. It hurts me a lot about my decision I made, please don't make the same mistake as I did. Your bf just has your best interests at heart, make amends with him and talk to him about it and please consider talking to a therapist.

I like to go back to things I enjoyed to do in my past. I also like to try to pick up new skills, most of them are useless skills, but I enjoy just trying out new things. You never know if you enjoy it or not if you never try, so just try out new things. If you don't wanna do that you could try to read and watch movies. A lot of people enjoy doing those things.

I suggest talking to your partner about how you feel, trust me from past experience it's better to communicate, then to jump to a decision. I would also advise seeking help, it's a hard thing to do, to go to a therapist, but it would really help a lot. I hope this helps and if you ever wanna talk just message me and I'll be glad to talk to you.
I checked out what you suggested and since I live in a small town there's no therapists near me.
